[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Number of Pairs of Interchangeable Rectangles** [LC 2001 · Number of Pairs of Interchangeable Rectangles](https://leetcode.com/problems/number-of-pairs-of-interchangeable-rectangles/){difficulty="Medium"}

"Same ratio" is really "same reduced fraction," and reducing a fraction is one gcd: divide
both parts by $\gcd(w, h)$ and every rectangle with ratio $p/q$ collapses to the identical
key $(p, q)$. So the geometric question becomes a *hashing* question - histogram the
reduced keys, and each bucket of size $f$ contributes $\binom{f}{2}$ pairs (@sec-gcd-a6).
You never compare two rectangles directly; you count how many share a canonical form.

[Solved in full in @sec-gcd-p2-rects.]{.card-link}

:::
